mappings.name: prompt excerpts contain only the latest direct human text, never tool or multimodal payloads
review_notes: Reviewed every baseline assertion and local parameter scenario. Exact serialized budgets are checked using the authoritative JsDocument/PromptState representation; observation-only serde projections are not wire serialization.
